# scm_dlp_edm_dataset (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Adopts an existing Enterprise DLP Exact Data Match (EDM) Dataset into Terraform state. EDM datasets are created and indexed out-of-band with the EDM CLI, so this resource never creates or deletes data: `terraform destroy` only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopt an EDM dataset that was already uploaded and indexed with the EDM CLI.
# Terraform never creates or deletes EDM data: destroying this resource only
# removes it from state.
resource "scm_dlp_edm_dataset" "customer_pii" {
  name = "Customer_PII_Dataset"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the EDM dataset.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the EDM dataset. If provided, the existing dataset is adopted into state; otherwise it is looked up by `name`.

### Read-Only

- `active_fields` (Attributes List) Active schema fields for the EDM dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_fields))
- `all_fields` (Attributes List) All schema fields for the EDM dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--all_fields))
- `index_error_code` (String) Error code if indexing failed.
- `index_status` (String) The index status of the dataset (e.g. COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS, FAILED).
- `region_name` (String) Region where the dataset is stored.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

<a id="nestedatt--active_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `active_fields`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Field identifier.
- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field type.


<a id="nestedatt--all_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `all_fields`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Field identifier.
- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP edm dataset by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_edm_dataset.example <id>
```
